title: Capture
does: Starts the target in the sandbox with tracing injected, runs the scenarios, probes one field at a time from a fresh state, then reads the schema and the source behind the routes. No AI.

tools.name: psql
tools.purpose: puts the database back to a known state before each run and each test

tools.name: Node child_process
tools.purpose: starts and stops the service under test

tools.name: OpenTelemetry Node SDK + auto-instrumentations
tools.purpose: injected with NODE_OPTIONS, traces every request through http, express and pg, and writes each span to a file

tools.name: Node fetch
tools.purpose: sends each request and records the response; adds a traceparent header so traces can be matched to it

tools.name: Trace linker
tools.purpose: groups spans by trace id and pulls out each request's route and SQL

tools.name: node-postgres (pg)
tools.purpose: reads tables, columns and constraints from the live database

tools.name: Source slicer
tools.purpose: finds the files that mention each route and follows their imports

inputs.label: Config: target
inputs.preview:
# One file describes the system under analysis. Point it at the real system when access lands.
out: out

target:
  name: demo-wallet
  baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:4001
  start:
    command: node demo-target/dist/server.js
    env:
      PORT: "4001"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/re_demo
  # node-auto injects OpenTelemetry into a Node process with no code changes.
  tracing: node-auto
  # Sandbox only: puts the data back to a known state before each run and probe.
  reset:
    command: psql postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/re_demo -q -f demo-target/schema.sql 2>/dev/null
  database:
    url: postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/re_demo
  source:
    dir: demo-target/src
    extensions: [.ts, .js]

scenarios: scenarios/demo.yaml

# Controlled probing: on steps marked `probe: true`, try each value for each field, one at a time.
probes:
  fields: [amount]
  # 4.35 is a float trap: 4.35 * 100 is 434.99999999999994 in JavaScript.
  values: [0, -5, 0.005, 1.5, 199.99, 4999.99, 5000, 10000, 10000.01, "100", 4.35]
  dropHeaders: [Idempotency-Key]

analysis:
  model: claude-sonnet-5-5
  maxTokens: 16000

rebuild:
  dir: rebuilt
  model: claude-sonnet-5-5

# The rebuilt service, started the same way for verification and parity.
rebuilt:
  baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:4002
  start:
    command: node rebuilt/dist/server.js
    env:
      PORT: "4002"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/re_rebuilt
  reset:
    command: psql postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/re_rebuilt -q -f rebuilt/schema.sql 2>/dev/null
